ideas.pitch: A lightweight storage middleware that dynamically scales read and write quorums based on real-time node latency and partition health metrics, preventing split-brain states during network degradation.
ideas.title: Consensus-Guard: Self-Healing Dynamic Quorum for Cloud-Native Distributed Storage
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the 'System Convergence' theme by focusing on architectural resilience and fault tolerance rather than just a shallow prototype.

ideas.pitch: An open-source telemetry governance proxy that intercepts multi-agent LLM tool calls, evaluates compliance against pre-defined safety invariants, and logs tamper-evident audit trails.
ideas.title: Sentinel-AI: Ethical Telemetry and Policy Enforcement for Autonomous Agents
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates deep systems engineering and addresses real-world enterprise utility and security requirements.

ideas.pitch: A high-performance semantic routing proxy that maps incoming requests to optimal LLM backends using a kNN exemplar index and an asynchronous judge writeback loop.
ideas.title: SemanticRoute-Core: Zero-Training Self-Optimizing Router for Multi-Model Infrastructure
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets hard engineering performance metrics, cutting inference costs while maintaining high accuracy under heavy load.

ideas.pitch: A systems pipeline that parses BPMN workflow graphs and executes automated, multi-agent security scans and dependency risk analysis before deployment to production environments.
ideas.title: BPMN-Shield: Orchestrated Pre-Deployment Risk Diagnosis for Autonomous Workflows
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines rigorous workflow orchestration with verifiable risk assessment, fitting the demand for long-term scalability and real-world utility.

ideas.pitch: An offline-first background daemon that ingests git repositories, builds localized dependency graphs, and continuously generates architectural documentation and security vulnerability alerts.
ideas.title: RepoPulse-Enterprise: Automated Codebase Intelligence and Security Compliance Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Delivers an immediately working, highly practical developer tool with clear operational utility past the hackathon closing ceremony.
